results.description:
You didn't plan to become a caregiver. You just loved someone.

Now you're the one holding the appointment letter, the medication list, and the group chat nobody answers.

You're the one calling to check whether anyone visited. The one who knows what three different people promised to do this week.

There are days it feels like too much. Days when you wish someone else would step up, even for an hour. That feeling is not a failure. It's what happens when one person carries more than one person should.

The hardest part is not the doing. It is the knowing: being the one who always holds the full picture, because it lives only in your head.

KinCarer puts that picture somewhere the whole care circle can see it.

One shared schedule for tasks, visits and appointments. Check-ins so everyone knows someone arrived, without anyone having to call. A chat beside the schedule, where any message can become a task in two taps. Routines and medication notes, so whoever visits next knows what's needed. Care Files for the documents that matter, somewhere the whole circle can find them.

When the picture is shared, the load is shared. Not just the doing, but the knowing.

WHO KINCARER IS FOR
Families caring for an aging parent.
Brothers and sisters sharing the care from different states.
Partners caring for someone with dementia or a chronic condition.
Families caring alongside paid caregivers or a home care agency.
Anyone who has become the one who holds the full picture.

SHARED SCHEDULE
Add tasks, visits, appointments and reminders so everyone in the care circle can see what needs doing, who is doing it, and what has already happened.

CHECK-INS
Let the care circle know when someone has arrived at the care location. Turn on automatic check-ins and it takes one tap when a phone notices the arrival. KinCarer does not show live movement.

CIRCLE CHAT
Family and caregivers talk beside the schedule, not in another app. Anything decided in the chat can become a task or appointment in two taps, so nothing important gets buried.

ROUTINES AND MEDICATION
Keep daily routines, medication notes and care preferences together, so the next person helping knows what's needed.

HANDOVER NOTES
Leave an update after visits, appointments or changes so everyone stays in the loop without repeating the same messages.

CARE FILES
Store doctor's letters, care plans, photos and other documents in one place, so your care circle can find what matters when they need it.

CLARA AI ASSISTANT
Ask Clara what happened today, who checked in, or what is still waiting for someone. Clara answers only from what your circle has written down. Clara is optional and does not give medical advice.

CARE CIRCLE
Invite family members, friends, neighbors or paid caregivers. Roles and permissions help make sure people see the right information for how they are helping.

ONE SUBSCRIPTION FOR THE WHOLE CIRCLE
Family+ is one plan for the whole care circle, paid monthly or yearly, with 14 days free on the yearly plan. One subscription covers everyone: there is no member limit, and everyone you invite joins free. If Family+ ends, the circle becomes read-only until someone renews. Nothing is deleted.

KinCarer does not replace the love, judgment or care you already give. It helps you organize it, share it and feel less alone carrying it.

Download KinCarer and share the load.

Important: KinCarer is a family care coordination and planning app. It does not provide medical advice, diagnosis, treatment, emergency response, safeguarding services or professional care services. Clara AI provides organizational support only and should not replace advice from qualified professionals.

Subscriptions renew automatically unless canceled in your App Store settings.

Privacy Policy: https://kincarer.com/privacy

Caring Village is the all-in-one app for family caregivers. Coordinate medications, schedules, tasks, and documents — and keep your whole care circle in the loop — without the chaos of texts, spreadsheets, and missed calls. Whether you're managing an aging parent's care from across the country or coordinating with siblings across town, Caring Village keeps everyone on the same page.

Why Caring Village?

Caregiving is rarely one person's job — but it often ends up that way. Multiple schedules, medications to track, documents to find, decisions to make together. Caring Village brings it all into one secure, family-focused platform so you can spend less time managing logistics and more time being present.

Key Features:

Julia – Your AI Caregiving Assistant
Meet Julia, your AI-powered caregiving assistant. Available anytime, Julia answers questions, offers guidance, and helps families make more informed decisions throughout the caregiving journey.

Advanced Medication Management
Set detailed medication reminders, track adherence, and share updates with your care circle. No more wondering if a dose was taken.

Shared Care Calendar
Keep everyone aligned with a shared calendar that syncs with external calendars so appointments don't slip through the cracks.

Printable Care Calendar
Export and print calendars for offline use or to share with doctors and family members.

Task Lists
Create and assign tasks to care circle members. Family members can volunteer for responsibilities — so caregiving is shared, not shouldered alone.

Expert-Curated Checklists
Access checklists built by caregiving experts to guide you through complex situations, from daily routines to emergency planning.

Customizable Care Plans
Design care plans tailored to your loved one's specific needs, with flexible reminders to stay on track.

Wellness Journal
Track moods, symptoms, and milestones. Share photos and updates with your care circle, where family members can like, comment, and stay emotionally connected — even from a distance.

Secure Document Storage
Store and organize medical records, insurance forms, and legal documents in one secure hub. Everything in one place when you need it most.

Built for Families Who Share the Load

Caregiving doesn't have to fall on one person. Caring Village makes it easy for your whole family to step in — volunteer for tasks, track medications, read updates — so the load is shared and nothing gets missed. Whether your family lives under one roof or across time zones, you'll have the tools to stay aligned, divide responsibilities, and show up for each other.

Who Is Caring Village For?


Family caregivers supporting aging parents
Spouses and partners managing chronic conditions
Families coordinating care across multiple households
Anyone who wants to get organized and share the caregiving load


Over 85,000 families use Caring Village to coordinate care and keep everyone in it.

Download today and see what organized caregiving looks like.

results.description:
Somehow you became the one who keeps track of it all — the pills, the appointments, who said they'd stop by. When a parent is getting older, a partner is in treatment, or someone you love needs care every day, it almost always lands on one person: you.

CircleCare shares the load. Create one care circle around the person you care for, invite the people who help, and everyone works from the same up-to-date picture, whether they live down the street or across the country.

EVERYONE ON THE SAME PAGE
- Medications, appointments, tasks and notes in one shared place
- See who did what: who gave a dose, who finished a task, who left a note
- The activity feed shows every update from everyone in the circle, so nobody has to ask "did anyone check?"
- With reminders on, if a dose isn't marked in time, the alert goes to the person taking it, then to the caregivers, then to the whole circle

MEDICATIONS, SHARED
- Daily, weekly or custom schedules, with reminders
- Mark a dose taken or skipped, and the whole circle sees it
- New: as-needed medications. Log a dose when it's given, like a pain reliever, and everyone can see when the last one was given and by whom

APPOINTMENTS AND TASKS
- One shared calendar for doctor visits, treatments and tests
- Assign tasks and appointments to someone, or leave them open for whoever can help
- Add notes and questions so the next person knows what happened

NEW: THE DAILY UPDATE
Each evening at 7 pm, the Home screen shows a short summary of what the circle logged that day. If something was logged, you get one quiet notification, with no health details in it. It's free, and you can turn it off.

HEALTH INFO WHEN IT MATTERS
Allergies, conditions, doctors, insurance and emergency contacts in one place, ready to share as text or a PDF. Keep documents like test results and insurance cards with the circle too.

FREE TO START, FAIR AS YOUR TEAM GROWS
Free: 1 care circle for you + 1 caregiver. The person you care for can join too and doesn't count toward that. Medications and reminders are free forever. No credit card needed.

Premium, for families with more helping hands:
- Unlimited family members: everyone who helps, in one circle
- Add by voice: say a medication, task or appointment and we fill in the form for you to check. On supported phones.
- Adherence reports to share with doctors, plus calendar import
- 1 GB of documents per circle
- AI care assistant
- Up to 5 care circles

Monthly or yearly, priced fairly for your country. Yearly includes a free trial. Only the person who creates the circle pays. Invited family members never pay.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
This is your family's health information, not ad data. No ads. We never sell your data. Only the people you invite can see your circle.

IN 8 LANGUAGES
English, Spanish, French, French (Canada), German, Italian, Portuguese (Brazil) and Portuguese (Portugal). Everyone chooses their own.

GET STARTED IN A FEW MINUTES
Create a care circle, add a medication or an appointment, and invite your family. Nobody should have to carry this alone.

Terms of Use: https://circlecare.app/terms/
Privacy Policy: https://circlecare.app/privacy/

Lively Link™, a free app for your smartphone, keeps you informed about the health and safety of loved ones who subscribe to a Lively Health and Safety plan.

Link can provide peace of mind by sharing timely updates about your loved one. You can check in with them when you want, from anywhere, without disturbing them – helping them maintain the independent life they love.

Exclusive features help them stay independent and you feel reassured.

Once you accept the invite from your loved one and successfully set up Link, you’re able to access the following features:

Receive Emergency Alerts

Link will send you notifications for selected actions including when your loved one has contacted Urgent Response on their Lively device, allowing you to make decisions quickly and follow up without delay. 

Retrieve Location

When the locator permissions are on you will see your loved one’s location on a map and receive updates if they change location. These general updates happen approximately every 20 minutes. 

In an emergency, First Responders get location updates every 30 seconds. 

Check Activities
Based on information in the Lively device user’s Personal Profile, see if appointments are being kept and receive other reports about their activities.

Check Device Status

Get peace of mind knowing your loved one always has access to a professional in the event of an emergency. Link will let you know the Lively device Battery Status. You’ll also be notified when the battery is low so you can remind your loved one to recharge or replace the battery and stay connected. 

Get Articles to Help You Support Your Loved One

Resource center featuring helpful articles, advice and tips for seniors and their loved ones.

Personalization

The Link team cares that the app is tailored to you. That’s why there are settings allowing you to choose which notifications you receive, add a picture of your loved one and even save their phone number – so you can call them directly from the app.

We want you to have a great app experience. If you have any questions about the Link app or simply can’t find your favorite features, email us at customerservice@lively.com we’ll be glad to help.

https://www.lively.com/link

Technical Help

Find answers to common questions in our FAQs. For additional assistance, tap ‘Contact Us’ from Link or call (800) 733-6632.

Use the JubileeTV app to support your aging loved one on their TV in a way that's easy for them and convenient for you.

  • Place a video call from The App and it will automatically pop up on your loved one’s TV.

  • Automatically turn on the TV and connect a video call when it’s critical without any interaction required from your loved one

  • Share photos and short video clips right from your phone to Mom’s TV - a great way to let her know you care.

  • Set up reminders for medical appointments, daily household tasks and more to give your loved one a gentle nudge while supporting their independence.

  • Schedule a daily check-in message to appear on your loved one’s TV and receive a notification if they don’t check in my a certain time. 

  • See real-time insights into your aging loved one’s television habits. 

  • Get notified when the TV is turned on for added peace of mind.
